summary.text: Michelle McGaw is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 71 since January 5, 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a pharmacist, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: McGaw lives in Portsmouth, Rhode Island, and graduated from St. Paul Catholic High School in 1984.
She earned a degree from the University of Rhode Island College of Pharmacy in 1989 and has worked as a consultant pharmacist.
She co-founded the Portsmouth Trash Collaborative.
